spans.s:
vikara, cf. vikara-padāni (LP), a small present, a bonus; cf. Gujarātī pān-sopārī.
 (LP), cf. vikara-pada explained as ‘miscellancous expenses’.

vikṣepa (IA 7, 13), cf. vijaya-vikṣepa used as an epithet of the place whence a royal charter was issued; cf. vijaya-vikṣepāt Bha-rukaccha-vāsakāt; wrongly interpreted as ‘a camp or cantonment’ (IA 17). See also Vaikṣepika.
